settings.heading: Fast, expert care for everyday conditions — no GP appointment needed
settings.intro: Our pharmacists can assess and, where appropriate, prescribe treatment for a range of common conditions during a private in-store consultation. Call your local pharmacy to book, or walk in.
settings.conditions_intro: Our pharmacists can help with the following common conditions. If we can’t treat your condition, we’ll point you in the right direction.
settings.stores_intro: The service runs in all seven of our pharmacies. Call the one nearest you and we will book you in.

settings.title: Same-day appointments
settings.text: Skip the wait for a GP. Most patients are seen the same day.

settings.title: Walk-ins welcome
settings.text: Booking is recommended, but walk-ins are accepted, subject to how busy the pharmacy is.

settings.title: No GP referral needed
settings.text: For the conditions below, our pharmacist can assess you and, where appropriate, prescribe treatment without a GP visit or referral.

settings.title: €20 consultation
settings.text: Flat consultation fee, paid in store. Any medicine prescribed is charged separately, and may be covered under the Medical Card or Drugs Payment Scheme.

settings.title: Call to book, or walk in
settings.text: Phone your local pharmacy and we will find you a time, usually the same day. You can also call in without an appointment.

settings.title: Private consultation
settings.text: Sit down with our pharmacist in a private, confidential room. They will ask about your symptoms, your health and any medicines you take.

settings.title: Treatment and advice
settings.text: You will get expert clinical advice. Where appropriate, the pharmacist can prescribe and dispense the right treatment for your condition on the spot.

settings.question: How much does it cost?
settings.answer: The consultation fee is €20. This is a private charge that applies to everyone. If the pharmacist prescribes a medicine, that is charged separately, and it may be covered under the Medical Card or Drugs Payment Scheme.

settings.question: Do I need a GP appointment or referral?
settings.answer: No. For the conditions listed above, our pharmacist can assess you and, where appropriate, prescribe treatment without a GP visit or referral.

settings.question: Do I have to book in advance?
settings.answer: Booking is recommended so we can have a private consultation room ready and keep your wait to a minimum. Call your local pharmacy to book. We also accept walk-ins, subject to how busy the pharmacy is.

settings.question: Which pharmacies offer the service?
settings.answer: The Common Conditions Service is available at all of our pharmacies:

settings.question: What if my condition can’t be treated here?
settings.answer: If your condition falls outside the service or needs further care, our pharmacist will give you clear advice and, where needed, refer you to your GP or another service.
